end.summary:
Named earthworm, ant, and millipede as animals found in soil or leaf litter.
Discussed that insects have six legs.
Pihu said all small crawling animals are insects; this mix-up was not corrected by the end.
Lesson ended when Pihu said they were tired and did not want to continue.
end.parentNote: Pihu practised naming small soil animals and discussed the six legs of insects. They identified earthworms, ants, and millipedes, but the idea that all small crawling animals are insects remained and was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, sort picture cards into “insects” and “not insects,” reminding them that earthworms have no legs while insects have six.
